governance_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#how-changes-are-decided (how changes are decided, who holds which access)
roles_responsibilities_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles-and-responsibilities lists the maintainer, contributor and automation roles and who holds each: https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles-and-responsibilities
access_continuity_justification: Not met: one maintainer holds all access, see https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#access-continuity. The project is MIT licensed and public so anyone can fork it, but no second person can release or merge within a week
bus_factor_justification: Not met: a single maintainer, see https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#access-continuity and the residual risks in https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/docs/security-assessment.md#residual-risks
documentation_roadmap_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/ROADMAP.md covers the next twelve months and lists what is not planned
documentation_architecture_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/docs/design.md#actors-and-actions (actors, components, external interfaces) and the code layout in https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/DEVELOPMENT.md#code-layout
documentation_security_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/docs/security-assessment.md#what-matters states what matters, the threats and what the user can rely on; reporting and supported versions are in https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/SECURITY.md#what-to-expect
documentation_current_justification: Documentation changes ship in the same pull request as the code (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests), each release is described in https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md, and https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/docs/security-assessment.md names the release it was last reviewed for
documentation_achievements_justification: The badge row at the top of https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/README.md links the OpenSSF Best Practices badge (https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/15610), OpenSSF Scorecard (https://scorecard.dev/viewer/?uri=github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen) and REUSE (https://reuse.software/)
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: The app plays full-screen video with a title overlay and a small remote-control menu on the TV's own platform, and the project site is GitHub; there is no text-entry or web content of its own beyond the demo (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/README.md#using-it)
internationalization_justification: Not met: the menu strings in https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/js/menu.js are English literals with no localization layer
maintenance_or_update_justification: Only the latest release is maintained (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions); upgrading is deploying the new release the same way as the first install (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/README.md#install) with no migration steps, and stored settings are validated on read so older values load (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/docs/design.md#external-interfaces)
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: No vulnerability has been reported or resolved in the last 12 months (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/security/advisories); https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/SECURITY.md#credit commits to naming reporters
vulnerability_response_process_justifica: https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/SECURITY.md#handling-a-report: private acknowledgement within 7 days, fix or assessment within 30 days, coordinated disclosure, published advisory
coding_standards_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#coding-standard (ES5, two-space indent, single quotes, semicolons), https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/.editorconfig and https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/eslint.config.js
coding_standards_enforced_justification: ESLint (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/eslint.config.js) runs as `npm run lint` in the test job of https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml and fails the build
build_standard_variables_justification: No native binaries are built: the package is plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/README.md#development)
build_preserve_debug_justification: There is no compile step (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#getting-set-up), so no debugging information is stripped
build_non_recursive_justification: There is no build system with subdirectories, only https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/demo/build.sh which assembles the demo
build_repeatable_justification: The release archive is made by `git archive` with files stored uncompressed, so the same tag gives the same bytes: https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml, the recipe in https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/README.md#rebuild-a-release-yourself and https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/test/reproducible.test.sh
installation_common_justification: Install with the Docker one-liner or `./setup.sh && ./deploy.sh`, and uninstall it from the TV's apps list or with sdb (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/README.md#quick-start): https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/README.md#install, https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/setup.sh, https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/deploy.sh
installation_standard_variables_justific: The app is installed onto a TV over sdb, not into a filesystem prefix, so DESTDIR-style conventions do not exist (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/deploy.sh)
installation_development_quick_justifica: `npm ci && ./test/run-all.sh` installs the dev tools and runs every suite: https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#getting-set-up and https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/DEVELOPMENT.md#running-it-without-a-tv
external_dependencies_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/package.json and https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/package-lock.json for npm, hash-pinned pip requirements in https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/tree/main/.github/requirements, and SHA-pinned actions in https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/tree/main/.github/workflows; there are no runtime dependencies
dependency_monitoring_justification: Dependabot (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml) proposes weekly npm, pip and Actions updates and osv-scanner runs in https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/.github/workflows/security.yml on every push and weekly
updateable_reused_components_justificati: No third-party code is copied into the repository; dev tools come from npm through https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/package-lock.json and update through Dependabot (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml)
interfaces_current_justification: The app targets the current Tizen 6.0 baseline with AVPlay and tizen.preference (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/docs/design.md#external-interfaces, https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/ROADMAP.md); the ES5 syntax is a Chromium 76 constraint explained in https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#what-is-generated-and-what-is-hand-written
automated_integration_testing_justificat: https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml runs lint, tests with coverage and fuzzing on every push and pull request, and the Actions run page reports pass or fail (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
regression_tests_added50_justification: A `fix:` commit must change a test or carry a No-Test trailer: https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/tools/check-tests.sh, https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/.github/workflows/tests-policy.yml, https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/test/tests-policy.test.sh
test_statement_coverage80_justification: c8 gates statements, branches, functions and lines at 90 percent (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/.c8rc.json) in https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml; the current run reports 99.6 percent statements and 90.9 percent branches
implement_secure_design_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/docs/security-assessment.md#threats-and-what-limits-them (assurance case: least privilege, economy of mechanism, fail-safe defaults, complete mediation, open design)
crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: The project implements no cryptography; release signing is done by cosign in https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml
crypto_credential_agility_justification: The telemetry client token is read from the untracked local-config file listed in https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/.gitignore (template: https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/js/local-config.example.js), separate from the code and replaceable without changing any code
crypto_used_network_justification: Not met: Apple publishes its video only over plain HTTP, so the app streams it that way; the risk is accepted in https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/docs/security-assessment.md. Telemetry and the demo proxy use HTTPS
crypto_tls12_justification: The app has no TLS code; its HTTPS requests go through the TV's web engine, which sets the protocol versions (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/docs/design.md#external-interfaces)
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: The app has no TLS code and never disables certificate checks: its HTTPS requests use the TV's web engine defaults (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/js/telemetry.js)
crypto_verification_private_justificatio: The app has no TLS code; the TV's web engine verifies the certificate before sending any request (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/js/telemetry.js)
signed_releases_justification: Every release zip has a cosign keyless Sigstore bundle made in https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml (no private key exists to leak), and users verify it with the command in https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/README.md#verify-a-release; see https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/releases/latest
version_tags_signed_justification: Not met: tags are lightweight and unsigned; the release assets are signed instead (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/releases/latest) and the ruleset https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/rules stops anyone rewriting a v* tag
input_validation_justification: Stored settings are clamped to allowlisted ranges on load (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/js/settings.js), the Worker answers only allowlisted methods, paths and origins (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/worker/index.mjs), and https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/test/fuzz.test.js fuzzes the settings parser
hardening_justification: The demo page ships a Content Security Policy that allows scripts only from its own origin (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/demo/build.sh), the proxy Worker sends X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/worker/index.mjs), and CI workflows run with least-privilege tokens and SHA-pinned actions (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml)
assurance_case_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/docs/security-assessment.md#assurance-case: threat model, trust boundaries, secure design principles and countered weaknesses
copyright_per_file_justification: Each source file starts with an SPDX copyright line, enforced by https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/test/spdx.test.sh; the two generated data files https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/js/catalog.js and https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/js/h264map.js are covered by https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/REUSE.toml and checked by `reuse lint` in https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
license_per_file_justification: Each source file starts with an SPDX licence identifier line for MIT, enforced by https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/test/spdx.test.sh; generated data files are covered by https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/REUSE.toml and checked by `reuse lint` in https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
small_tasks_justification: Not met: the good first issue label exists (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/labels/good%20first%20issue) but no small task is open right now (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/issues)
require_2FA_justification: GitHub requires two-factor authentication of every account that contributes code (https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/raising-the-bar-for-software-security-github-2fa-begins-march-13/), and https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#members-with-access-to-sensitive-resources records that the maintainer account uses it; only the maintainer can change the repository
secure_2FA_justification: Not verified: GitHub does not expose the second factor type to the project, so a cryptographic factor cannot be shown; see https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#members-with-access-to-sensitive-resources
code_review_standards_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-review: every change goes through a pull request, what the reviewer checks and when it is accepted; reviewers are named in https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS
two_person_review_justification: Not met: with one maintainer the author is the only reviewer; branch rulesets require pull requests and passing checks but not a second approver (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/rules)
build_reproducible_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/README.md#rebuild-a-release-yourself: `git archive --format=zip -0` of the tag gives the published bytes, as run in https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml and tested by https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/test/reproducible.test.sh
test_statement_coverage90_justification: c8 fails the build below 90 percent statements (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/.c8rc.json, https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml); the current run is 99.6 percent
test_branch_coverage80_justification: c8 fails the build below 90 percent branches (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/.c8rc.json, https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml); the current run is 90.9 percent
hardened_site_justification: Not met: github.com sends the hardening headers, but the demo site https://aerial.jeansouza.dev is served by GitHub Pages, which sends no HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options or nosniff header and cannot be configured to; the page carries a CSP meta tag instead (https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/demo/build.sh)
security_review_justification: https://github.com/jeancarlos/aerial-tizen/blob/main/docs/security-assessment.md#assurance-case is a review of the security requirements, trust boundaries and threats, last done for release 1.0.2; no independent third party has reviewed the project
